name: Aboriginal Fund for Species at Risk: Aquatic Programming
summary: Funds Indigenous communities and organizations in Canada (or partners they mandate) to improve habitat, mitigate threats and build stewardship capacity for aquatic species at risk. The 2027-28 call is open.

eligibility.rule: Target species have Endangered, Threatened or Special Concern status under SARA or COSEWIC
Project activities directly benefit aquatic species at risk and meet programme eligibilities
Propose a 1-year project for the 2027 to 2028 funding year
A partner applicant has a community letter confirming its formal mandate
No captive breeding, hatcheries, aquaculture, reintroductions, recovery plans or federal-mandate research
Activities for species with federal recovery documents closely link to prescribed recovery actions
Outreach activities lead directly to on-the-ground species recovery action
Receive funding from only one federal funding programme for each proposed activity

documents: Community letter of support confirming the partner organisation's formal mandate, if applicable

calls.label: 2027-28 call for proposals

status.quote: The 2027 to 2028 Call for proposals is now open.

deadline.quote: Completed application forms will be accepted until 11:59 (PST) on December 11, 2026.

calls.note: The AFSAR program is no longer accepting EOI's as part of the application process.

administered_by.quote: as all aquatic AFSAR proposals are administered by Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO)

applicant_types.quote: Indigenous communities and organizations located in Canada are eligible for funding.

geography.quote: Project activities may take place in freshwater and marine areas across Canada

access.quote: The Application form is available as a fillable form

window.quote: Completed application forms will be accepted until 11:59 (PST) on December 11, 2026.

co_finance_required.quote: You must obtain contributions of non-federal support (cash and/or in-kind) to obtain AFSAR funds.

effort.quote: Applications must be submitted to the appropriate regional email address by 23:59 Pacific Standard Time (PST) December 11, 2026.

eligibility.quote: Only proposals targeting species identified as Endangered, Threatened or of Special Concern will be eligible for funding. This applies to species listed on Schedule 1 of SARA, as well as unlisted species that have received a corresponding status assessment from the Committee on the Status of Endangered Wildlife in Canada (COSEWIC).
provided the proposed activities have a direct benefit to aquatic species at risk and adhere to other program eligibilities.
Only 1-year project proposals will be eligible for consideration in 2027 to 2028.
providing a letter of support from the community clearly indicates that the submitting organization has been formally mandated to do so.

Captive breeding, captive rearing, fish hatcheries, aquaculture, extirpated species reintroductions, the development of Recovery Strategies or Action Plans, including the identification of Critical Habitat (as required under SARA) and scientific research activities considered part of a federal mandate are not eligible for AFSAR funding.
For species with draft or completed federal recovery strategies, action plans or management plans, activities must be closely linked to prescribed recovery actions in those documents.
The activity should lead to direct SAR recovery action; general outreach or non- targeted activities will not be considered for funding.
You can only receive funding from one federal funding program for each proposed activity.

co_finance.quote: A minimum of 20% matching contributions (from non-federal sources) of the AFSAR funding amount is required ($0.20 match for each $1 of AFSAR funding) in order to be considered for AFSAR funding

after_award.quote: may require the provision of progress reports, annual reports (for multi- year projects) as well as a final report at the end of the project.

documents.quote: providing a letter of support from the community clearly indicates that the submitting organization has been formally mandated to do so.
